class _CouncilChoiceButton(QFrame):
    """دکمه گزینه با شماره و پشتیبانی از فارسی راست‌چین"""

    clicked = pyqtSignal(dict)

    def __init__(self, choice_data: dict, display_number: int,
                 parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.choice_data = choice_data
        self.setObjectName("councilChoice")
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        self.setMinimumHeight(70)

        self._apply_normal_style()

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 12)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        # ✅ در RTL، AlignLeft یعنی راست فیزیکی
        _R = (
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )

        # ─── شماره‌ی گزینه ───
        self.number_label = QLabel(f"{display_number}")
        self.number_label.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 16, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self.number_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4FC3F7; background: transparent; border: none;"
        )
        self.number_label.setFixedWidth(28)
        self.number_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.number_label.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.number_label)

        # ─── ستون متن: thought + متن اصلی ───
        text_col = QVBoxLayout()
        text_col.setSpacing(6)

        # ✅ نمایش توجیه درونی با 💭
        thought = choice_data.get("thought", "").strip()
        if thought:
            thought_lbl = QLabel(f"💭  {RLM}{thought}")
            thought_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
            thought_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
            thought_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #90A4AE; background: transparent; "
                "border: none; font-style: italic; padding: 2px 4px;"
            )
            thought_lbl.setLayoutDirection(
                Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
            )
            thought_lbl.setAlignment(_R)
            thought_lbl.setAttribute(
                Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
            )
            text_col.addWidget(thought_lbl)

            # خط جداکننده
            sep = QFrame()
            sep.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.HLine)
            sep.setStyleSheet(
                "background-color: #2B4A6F; "
                "max-height: 1px; border: none;"
            )
            sep.setAttribute(
                Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
            )
            text_col.addWidget(sep)

        # ─── متن اصلی گزینه ───
        text = choice_data.get(
            "text_fa", choice_data.get("text", "")
        )
        self.label = QLabel(f"{RLM}{text}")
        self.label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.label.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        self.label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; border: none;"
        )
        self.label.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        )
        self.label.setAlignment(_R)
        self.label.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        text_col.addWidget(self.label)

        layout.addLayout(text_col, 1)

    def _apply_normal_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#councilChoice {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 10px;
            }
        """)

    def _apply_hover_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#councilChoice {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                border-radius: 10px;
            }
        """)

    def enterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._apply_hover_style()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._apply_normal_style()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(self.choice_data)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

class _PressureSegments(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFixedHeight(28)
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        self.segments = []
        for _ in range(3):
            seg = QFrame()
            seg.setFixedHeight(18)
            seg.setSizePolicy(
                QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
                QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed,
            )
            self.segments.append(seg)
            layout.addWidget(seg)

        self.set_level(0)

    def set_level(self, level: int):
        colors = {1: "#4FC3F7", 2: "#FF8F00", 3: "#D32F2F"}
        for i, seg in enumerate(self.segments):
            if i < level:
                c = colors[level]
                seg.setStyleSheet(f"""
                    QFrame {{
                        background-color: {c};
                        border: 1px solid {c};
                        border-radius: 4px;
                    }}
                """)
            else:
                seg.setStyleSheet("""
                    QFrame {
                        background-color: #1A2A4A;
                        border: 1px solid #444444;
                        border-radius: 4px;
                    }
                """)

    def set_rolling(self):
        for seg in self.segments:
            seg.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame {
                    background-color: #2B4A6F;
                    border: 1px solid #4FC3F7;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                }
            """)

class AccountabilityDialogWidget(QWidget):
    """مکالمه سه‌مرحله‌ای با شورای عالی — نسخه 5.0"""

    round_completed = pyqtSignal(dict)
    finished = pyqtSignal(dict)

    def __init__(self, rounds_data, analyzer_config, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.rounds_data = rounds_data
        self.analyzer_config = analyzer_config

        # جایگشت فشار
        self.pressure_plan = random.sample([1, 2, 3], 3)
        print(
            f"   [COUNCIL] جایگشت فشار انتخاب شد: "
            f"{self.pressure_plan}"
        )

        self.current_round_index = -1
        self.current_round: dict | None = None
        self.round_results: list = []
        self.total_start_time = int(time.time() * 1000)

        self.current_pressure = 0
        self.question_start_time = 0
        self.roll_start_time = 0
        self.roll_duration_ms = analyzer_config.get(
            "activation_delay_ms", 1500
        )
        self.roll_target = 0
        self.is_rolling = False

        self.roll_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.roll_timer.timeout.connect(self._on_roll_tick)
        self.reveal_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.reveal_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self.reveal_timer.timeout.connect(self._on_pressure_revealed)

        self._setup_ui()
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        self._start_round(0)

    # ================================================================
    def _setup_ui(self):
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        main_layout.setContentsMargins(30, 12, 30, 12)
        main_layout.setSpacing(10)

        # سرصفحه
        header_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        header_layout.setSpacing(10)

        self.header_icon = QLabel("🏛")
        self.header_icon.setFont(QFont("Arial", 26))
        self.header_icon.setStyleSheet("border: none;")
        header_layout.addWidget(self.header_icon)

        self.header_label = QLabel("شورای عالی ایستگاه")
        hf = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 19, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        self.header_label.setFont(hf)
        self.header_label.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7;")
        header_layout.addWidget(self.header_label)
        header_layout.addStretch()

        self.round_counter = QLabel("آماده شروع")
        self.round_counter.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self.round_counter.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; padding: 4px 10px; "
            "border: 1px solid #FF8F00; border-radius: 6px;"
        )
        header_layout.addWidget(self.round_counter)

        main_layout.addLayout(header_layout)

        # نوار نشانگر دورها
        self.indicators_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.indicators_row.setSpacing(10)
        self.indicators_row.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter
        )

        self.round_indicators: list[_RoundIndicator] = []
        for i, rnd in enumerate(self.rounds_data):

    # ================================================================
    def _apply_pressure_theme(self, level: int):
        if level == 0:
            self.pressure_frame.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame {
                    background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.06);
                    border: 2px dashed #4FC3F7;
                    border-radius: 10px;
                }
            """)
            return
        meta = PRESSURE_META[level]
        self.pressure_frame.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame {{
                background-color: {meta['bg']};
                border: 2px solid {meta['color']};
                border-radius: 10px;
            }}
        """)

    # ================================================================
    def _start_round(self, index):
        if index >= len(self.rounds_data):
            self._finish_all()
            return

        self.current_round_index = index
        self.current_round = self.rounds_data[index]
        cr = self.current_round
        if cr is None:
            return

        # انیمیشن ورود کارت عضو
        self._animate_member_card_in()

        # نگاشت member_id JSON به کلید character_registry
        member_key_map = {
            "member_1": "council_science",   # دکتر مهرانی
            "member_2": "council_ethics",    # خانم آذری
            "member_3": "council_chair",     # آقای کیانی
        }
        member_key = member_key_map.get(
            cr.get("member_id", ""), ""
        )

        self.member_card.set_member(
            cr.get("member_name", ""),
            cr.get("member_role", ""),
            cr.get("member_icon", "👤"),
            member_key=member_key,
        )
        self.member_card.set_round(index + 1, len(self.rounds_data))
        self.member_card.set_pressure_color("#4FC3F7")

        for i, ind in enumerate(self.round_indicators):
            if i < index:
                ind.set_state("done")
            elif i == index:
                ind.set_state("active")
            else:
                ind.set_state("pending")

        self.round_counter.setText(
            f"دور {index + 1} از {len(self.rounds_data)}"
        )
        self.progress_bar.setValue(index)

        self.current_pressure = 0
        self.pressure_icon.setText("🎯")
        self.pressure_label.setText("وضعیت تحلیل‌گر: آماده")
        self.pressure_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4FC3F7; border: none; font-weight: bold;"
        )
        self.pressure_value_label.setText("—")
        self.pressure_value_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4FC3F7; border: none;"
        )
        self.pressure_segments.set_level(0)
        self._apply_pressure_theme(0)

        self._clear_choices()
        self.content_stack.setCurrentWidget(self.analyzer_page)
        self.analyzer_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.continue_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.setFocus()

    def _animate_member_card_in(self):
        """انیمیشن Fade + Slide برای کارت عضو"""
        try:
            effect = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(self.member_card)
            effect.setOpacity(0.0)
            self.member_card.setGraphicsEffect(effect)

            final_pos = self.member_card.pos()
            start_pos = QPoint(final_pos.x() + 40, final_pos.y())
            self.member_card.move(start_pos)

            fade = QPropertyAnimation(
                effect, b"opacity", self.member_card
            )
            fade.setDuration(320)
            fade.setStartValue(0.0)
            fade.setEndValue(1.0)
            fade.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)

            pos = QPropertyAnimation(
                self.member_card, b"pos", self.member_card
            )
            pos.setDuration(320)
            pos.setStartValue(start_pos)
            pos.setEndValue(final_pos)
            pos.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)

            def _cleanup():
                try:
                    self.member_card.setGraphicsEffect(None)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            fade.finished.connect(_cleanup)
            self._member_anim_fade = fade
            self._member_anim_pos = pos
            fade.start()
            pos.start()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در انیمیشن کارت عضو: {e}")

    def _clear_choices(self):
        while self.choices_container.count():
            item = self.choices_container.takeAt(0)
            if item is None:
                continue
            w = item.widget()
            if w is not None:
                w.deleteLater()

    # ================================================================
    def _on_activate_analyzer(self):
        self.analyzer_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.roll_target = self.pressure_plan[
            self.current_round_index
        ]
        print(
            f"   [COUNCIL] فشار دور {self.current_round_index + 1} "
            f"= {self.roll_target} "
            f"(از جایگشت {self.pressure_plan})"
        )
        self.is_rolling = True
        self.roll_start_time = int(time.time() * 1000)

        self.pressure_icon.setText("⏳")
        self.pressure_label.setText("در حال سنجش شاخص‌ها...")
        self.pressure_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; border: none; font-weight: bold;"
        )
        self.pressure_value_label.setText("...")
        self.pressure_value_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
        )
        self.pressure_segments.set_rolling()

        self.content_stack.setCurrentWidget(self.rolling_page)
        self.roll_timer.start(80)
        self.reveal_timer.start(self.roll_duration_ms)

    def _on_roll_tick(self):
        self.pressure_segments.set_rolling()

    def _on_pressure_revealed(self):
        self.roll_timer.stop()
        self.is_rolling = False
        self.current_pressure = self.roll_target

        # صدای اعلام فشار
        try:
            from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
            get_audio_manager().play_sfx("scan")
        except Exception:
            pass

        meta = PRESSURE_META[self.current_pressure]
        self.pressure_segments.set_level(self.current_pressure)
        self.pressure_value_label.setText(
            f"{self.current_pressure} از ۳"
        )
        self.pressure_value_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {meta['color']}; border: none; "
            "font-weight: bold;"
        )
        self.pressure_icon.setText(meta["icon"])
        self.pressure_label.setText(
            f"سطح فشار: {meta['label']} — {meta['desc']}"
        )
        self.pressure_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {meta['color']}; border: none; "
            "font-weight: bold;"
        )
        self._apply_pressure_theme(self.current_pressure)
        self.member_card.set_pressure_color(meta["color"])

        cr = self.current_round
        if cr is None:
            return

        question_text = cr.get(
            "question_by_pressure", {}
        ).get(str(self.current_pressure), "—")
        self.question_speaker.setText(
            f"{cr.get('member_name', '')} — "
            f"{cr.get('member_role', '')}"
        )
        self.question_text.setText(question_text)
        self._build_choices()
        self.content_stack.setCurrentWidget(self.question_page)
        self.question_start_time = int(time.time() * 1000)
        self.setFocus()

    def _build_choices(self):
        self._clear_choices()
        cr = self.current_round
        if cr is None:
            return

        import re
        _PATTERN = re.compile(
            r"\n\n\(توجیه منطقی:\s*(.+?)\)\s*$",
            re.DOTALL,
        )

        choices = cr.get("choices", [])
        for i, choice in enumerate(choices):
            clean_choice = dict(choice)
            raw_text = clean_choice.get("text_fa", "")
            m = _PATTERN.search(raw_text)
            if m:
                # ✅ استخراج توجیه به فیلد جدا
                clean_choice["thought"] = m.group(1).strip()
                clean_choice["text_fa"] = _PATTERN.sub(
                    "", raw_text
                ).strip()

            btn = _CouncilChoiceButton(clean_choice, i + 1)
            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_choice_made)
            self.choices_container.addWidget(btn)

    # ================================================================
    def _on_choice_made(self, choice):
        cr = self.current_round
        if cr is None:
            return

        choice_id = choice.get("id", 0)
        decision_time = (
            int(time.time() * 1000) - self.question_start_time
        )

        round_result = {
            "round_index": self.current_round_index,
            "member_id": cr.get("member_id", ""),
            "pressure": self.current_pressure,
            "choice_id": choice_id,
            "decision_time_ms": decision_time,
        }
        self.round_results.append(round_result)
        self.round_completed.emit(round_result)

        # ✅ استخراج واکنش با محافظت
        reactions_map = cr.get("reactions_by_choice", {}) or {}
        reactions = reactions_map.get(str(choice_id), [])
        print(
            f"   [COUNCIL] واکنش برای دور "
            f"{self.current_round_index + 1}, "
            f"انتخاب {choice_id}: "
            f"{len(reactions)} مورد"
        )

        if reactions:
            # ✅ ادغام همه‌ی واکنش‌ها در یک متن
            all_speakers = []
            all_texts = []
            for r in reactions:
                sp = r.get("speaker", "")
                if sp and sp not in all_speakers:
                    all_speakers.append(sp)
                all_texts.append(r.get("text_fa", ""))

            self.reaction_speaker.setText(
                " / ".join(all_speakers)
            )
            # ✅ جدا کردن جملات با <br><br>
            self.reaction_text.setText(
                "<br><br>".join(all_texts)
            )

            if self.current_pressure == 3:
                self.reaction_icon.setText("😠")
            elif self.current_pressure == 2:
                self.reaction_icon.setText("🤔")
            else:
                self.reaction_icon.setText("💬")
        else:
            # ✅ fallback اگر واکنش ثبت نشده بود
            print(
                f"   [COUNCIL] ⚠️ واکنش برای این دور ثبت نشده "
                f"— نمایش پیام پیش‌فرض"
            )
            self.reaction_speaker.setText(
                cr.get("member_name", "شورا")
            )
            self.reaction_text.setText(
                "(شورا بدون واکنش ثبت‌شده، به عضو بعدی "
                "می‌رود.)"
            )
            self.reaction_icon.setText("💬")

        self.content_stack.setCurrentWidget(self.reaction_page)

        if self.current_round_index < len(self.rounds_data) - 1:
            next_name = self.rounds_data[
                self.current_round_index + 1
            ].get("member_name", "عضو بعدی")
            self.continue_btn.setText(
                f"▼  برای ادامه به {next_name} کلیک کنید  ▼"
            )
        else:
            self.continue_btn.setText(
                "▼  برای پایان جلسه‌ی شورا کلیک کنید  ▼"
            )
        self.continue_btn.setVisible(True)

        # ✅ محافظت از پرش ناخواسته:
        #    به مدت 600ms، ادامه غیرفعال است تا بازیکن واکنش را ببیند
        self.continue_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self._continue_enabled = False

        def _enable_continue():
            try:
                self._continue_enabled = True
                self.continue_btn.setEnabled(True)
            except RuntimeError:
                pass

        QTimer.singleShot(600, _enable_continue)

        self.setFocus()

    def _on_continue(self):
        self.continue_btn.setVisible(False)
        self._start_round(self.current_round_index + 1)

    # ================================================================
    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            super().mousePressEvent(event)
            return

        current = self.content_stack.currentWidget()

        if current is self.analyzer_page:
            if self.analyzer_btn.isEnabled():
                self._on_activate_analyzer()
            return

        if current is self.reaction_page:
            if self.continue_btn.isVisible():
                self._on_continue()
            return

        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    # ================================================================
    def handle_space(self) -> bool:
        current = self.content_stack.currentWidget()
        if current is self.reaction_page:
            # ✅ فقط اگر continue فعال شده باشد (بعد از ۶۰۰ms)
            if (self.continue_btn.isVisible()
                    and self.continue_btn.isEnabled()):
                self._on_continue()
                return True
        if current is self.analyzer_page:
            if self.analyzer_btn.isEnabled():
                self._on_activate_analyzer()
                return True
        return False

    def _finish_all(self):
        self.progress_bar.setValue(len(self.rounds_data))
        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.total_start_time
        result = {
            "rounds": self.round_results,
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
        }
        self.finished.emit(result)

"""
ویجت پس‌زمینه هوشمند
- اگر تصویر در assets/backgrounds/{key}_v01.png باشد، استفاده می‌کند
- در غیر این صورت، گرادیانت با رنگ‌های theme رسم می‌کند

نسخه: 1.1.0 (رفع خطاهای Pylance)
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QPainter, QLinearGradient, QColor, QPixmap, QPen
)
import os

from config import ASSETS_DIR


class BackgroundWidget(QWidget):
    """پس‌زمینه با پشتیبانی از تصویر + gradient fallback"""

    # ✅ پالت‌های رنگی برای هر موقعیت
    THEMES = {
        "menu":        ("#0B1D3A", "#2B4A6F"),
        "space":       ("#000510", "#0B1D3A"),
        "airlock":     ("#1A2A4A", "#4A3A2B"),
        "corridor":    ("#0F1E38", "#2B4A6F"),
        "control":     ("#0B1D3A", "#3A5A7F"),
        "reactor":     ("#3A1A0A", "#8B4513"),
        "coolant":     ("#1A0A0A", "#D32F2F"),
        "data_center": ("#050A18", "#2B4A6F"),
        "council":     ("#1A1A1A", "#B0BEC5"),
        "default":     ("#0B1D3A", "#2B4A6F"),
    }

    def __init__(self, theme_key: str = "default",
                 image_key: str | None = None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.theme_key = theme_key
        self.image_key = image_key
        # ✅ تعریف صریح برای Pylance
        self._pixmap: QPixmap | None = None
        self._try_load_image()
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_StyledBackground, True)

    def _try_load_image(self):
        """تلاش برای بارگذاری تصویر از assets/backgrounds"""
        if self.image_key:
            path = os.path.join(
                ASSETS_DIR, "backgrounds", f"{self.image_key}_v01.png"
            )
            if os.path.exists(path):
                pm = QPixmap(path)
                if not pm.isNull():
                    self._pixmap = pm
                    return

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore[reportIncompatibleMethodOverride]
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform)

        # ✅ اگر تصویر موجود است، با پوشش کامل رسم کن
        if self._pixmap is not None:
            scaled = self._pixmap.scaled(
                self.size(),
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
            )
            x = (self.width() - scaled.width()) // 2
            y = (self.height() - scaled.height()) // 2
            painter.drawPixmap(x, y, scaled)
            # ✅ لایه تاریک برای خوانایی متن
            painter.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(0, 0, 0, 80))
            return

        # ✅ گرادیانت fallback با جزئیات بیشتر برای عمق بصری
        top, bottom = self.THEMES.get(
            self.theme_key, self.THEMES["default"]
        )
        grad = QLinearGradient(0, 0, self.width(), self.height())
        grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(top))
        grad.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(bottom))
        grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(top))
        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), grad)

        # ✅ الگوی خطوط ظریف برای حس صنعتی
        pen = QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 15), 1)
        painter.setPen(pen)
        step = 40
        for x in range(0, self.width(), step):
            painter.drawLine(x, 0, x, self.height())
        for y in range(0, self.height(), step):
            painter.drawLine(0, y, self.width(), y)

"""
کمکی برای اتصال صدای کلیک به دکمه‌های عمومی
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QPushButton


def attach_click_sound(button: QPushButton):
    """افزودن صدای کلیک به یک دکمه"""
    button.clicked.connect(_play_click)


def _play_click():
    try:
        from core.audio_manager import get_audio_manager
        get_audio_manager().play_sfx("click")
    except Exception:
        pass

"""
ویجت کالیبراسیون طاقت‌فرسا — نسخه ۳.۰
==========================================
۶ حسگر با ۳ نوع مختلف + بازخورد بصری زنده

تغییرات نسخه ۳.۰:
- نوار هدف گرافیکی برای هر حسگر (محدوده‌ی سبز)
- بازخورد رنگی عدد (سبز = در محدوده)
- رنگ حاشیه‌ی کارت بر اساس وضعیت
- نوار پیشرفت ۶ نقطه‌ای
- حفظ API قبلی (submit_btn، shortcut_btn، signal)

نسخه: 3.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QSlider,
    QPushButton, QFrame, QMessageBox, QDial, QGridLayout,
    QSizePolicy
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import (
    Qt, pyqtSignal, QPointF, QRectF
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QFont, QPainter, QPen, QBrush, QColor
)
import time

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"


# ====================================================================
# نوار هدف گرافیکی
# ====================================================================
class _TargetZoneBar(QWidget):
    """نوار افقی که محدوده‌ی هدف را با رنگ سبز نشان می‌دهد"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        target: float,
        tolerance: float,
        val_min: float = 0.0,
        val_max: float = 100.0,
        parent=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.target = target
        self.tolerance = tolerance
        self.val_min = val_min
        self.val_max = val_max
        self._current = (val_min + val_max) / 2.0

        self.setMinimumHeight(8)
        self.setMaximumHeight(14)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

    def set_value(self, value: float):
        self._current = float(value)
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()
        margin = 4.0

        # پس‌زمینه
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(26, 42, 74)))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(
            QRectF(margin, 2, w - margin * 2, h - 4),
            3, 3,
        )

        # محدوده‌ی هدف (سبز)
        v_range = self.val_max - self.val_min
        if v_range > 0:
            low = self.target - self.tolerance
            high = self.target + self.tolerance
            x_low = (
                margin
                + (low - self.val_min) / v_range
                * (w - margin * 2)
            )
            x_high = (
                margin
                + (high - self.val_min) / v_range
                * (w - margin * 2)
            )
            x_low = max(margin, min(w - margin, x_low))
            x_high = max(margin, min(w - margin, x_high))

            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(76, 175, 80, 140)))
            painter.drawRect(
                QRectF(x_low, 2, x_high - x_low, h - 4)
            )

        # نشانگر موقعیت فعلی
        if v_range > 0:
            norm = (self._current - self.val_min) / v_range
        else:
            norm = 0.5
        norm = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm))
        x_pos = margin + norm * (w - margin * 2)

        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247), 1))
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255)))
        painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(x_pos, h / 2.0), 4, 4)

        painter.end()


# ====================================================================
# نوار پیشرفت نقطه‌ای
# ====================================================================
class _ProgressDots(QWidget):
    """ردیفی از نقاط که با رسیدن هر حسگر به هدف، سبز می‌شوند"""

    def __init__(self, count: int = 6, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.count = max(1, count)
        self._states: list = [False] * self.count

        self.setMinimumHeight(18)
        self.setMaximumHeight(18)
        self.setMinimumWidth(self.count * 22)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

    def set_state(self, index: int, in_zone: bool):
        if 0 <= index < self.count:
            self._states[index] = bool(in_zone)
            self.update()

    def reset(self):
        self._states = [False] * self.count
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()
        step = w / self.count
        radius = min(7.0, step * 0.3)

        for i in range(self.count):
            cx = step * (i + 0.5)
            cy = h / 2.0

            if self._states[i]:
                # در محدوده
                painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(76, 175, 80)))
                painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255), 2))
            else:
                # هنوز نه
                painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(60, 80, 110)))
                painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 180), 2))

            painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx, cy), radius, radius)

        painter.end()

    # ================================================================
    # حسگرها
    # ================================================================
    def _create_sensor_widget(self, sensor, index):
        stype = sensor.get("type", "horizontal")
        if stype == "dial":
            return self._create_dial_sensor(sensor, index)
        if stype == "vertical":
            return self._create_vertical_sensor(sensor, index)
        return self._create_horizontal_sensor(sensor, index)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _create_horizontal_sensor(self, sensor, index):
        frame = self._make_sensor_frame()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(frame)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(4)

        layout.addLayout(self._make_sensor_header(sensor))

        zone_bar = _TargetZoneBar(
            target=sensor["target"],
            tolerance=sensor["tolerance"],
            val_min=0.0, val_max=100.0,
        )
        layout.addWidget(zone_bar)
        self.zone_bars.append(zone_bar)

        import random
        slider = QSlider(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        slider.setRange(0, 1000)
        # ✅ مقدار اولیه با فاصله‌ی تصادفی از هدف — تا مسئله
        #    "خود به خود درست است" رخ ندهد
        target_slider = int(sensor["target"] * 10)
        offset = random.choice([-180, -120, 120, 180])
        initial = max(0, min(1000, target_slider + offset))
        slider.setValue(initial)
        slider.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight)
        slider.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self._apply_slider_style(slider, vertical=False)
        layout.addWidget(slider)

        value_lbl = self._make_value_label()
        layout.addWidget(
            value_lbl,
            alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
        )

        slider.valueChanged.connect(
            lambda v, lbl=value_lbl, idx=index, zb=zone_bar:
                self._on_control_changed(idx, v, lbl, zb)
        )

        self.controls.append(slider)
        self.value_labels.append(value_lbl)
        self.sensor_frames.append(frame)
        return frame

    # ================================================================
    # عناصر کمکی
    # ================================================================
    def _make_sensor_frame(self):
        f = QFrame()
        f.setStyleSheet(self._frame_normal_style())
        f.setSizePolicy(
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
        )
        return f

    def _frame_normal_style(self) -> str:
        return """
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.7);
                border: 1px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """

    def _frame_inzone_style(self) -> str:
        return """
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.7);
                border: 2px solid #4CAF50;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """

    def _make_sensor_header(self, sensor):
        h = QHBoxLayout()
        name_lbl = QLabel(sensor["name"])
        name_lbl.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 10, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
        )
        h.addWidget(name_lbl)
        h.addStretch()

        lo = sensor["target"] - sensor["tolerance"]
        hi = sensor["target"] + sensor["tolerance"]
        # ✅ LTR برای بازه‌ی عددی — تا در RTL جابجا نشود
        target_lbl = QLabel(f"هدف: {lo:.0f}–{hi:.0f}")
        target_lbl.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight)
        target_lbl.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )
        target_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 9))
        target_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4CAF50; border: none;"
        )
        target_lbl.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight
        )
        h.addWidget(target_lbl)
        return h

    def _make_value_label(self):
        lbl = QLabel("50.0")
        lbl.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #FF8F00; border: none;")
        lbl.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.LeftToRight)
        # ✅ عرض کوچک‌تر تا در پنجره‌ی کوچک فشرده نشود
        lbl.setMinimumWidth(40)
        lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        return lbl

    def _apply_slider_style(self, slider, vertical=False):
        if vertical:
            slider.setStyleSheet("""
                QSlider::groove:vertical {
                    width: 8px;
                    background: #1A2A4A;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    border: 1px solid #4FC3F7;
                }
                QSlider::handle:vertical {
                    background: #4FC3F7;
                    border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                    width: 14px;
                    height: 14px;
                    margin: 0 -4px;
                    border-radius: 7px;
                }
            """)
        else:
            slider.setStyleSheet("""
                QSlider::groove:horizontal {
                    height: 8px;
                    background: #1A2A4A;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    border: 1px solid #4FC3F7;
                }
                QSlider::handle:horizontal {
                    background: #4FC3F7;
                    border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                    width: 14px;
                    height: 14px;
                    margin: -4px 0;
                    border-radius: 7px;
                }
            """)

    # ================================================================
    # رویداد تغییر کنترل
    # ================================================================
    def _on_control_changed(self, index, raw_value, label, zone_bar):
        value = raw_value / 10.0
        label.setText(f"{value:.1f}")

        zone_bar.set_value(value)

        sensor = self.sensors[index]
        in_zone = (
            abs(value - sensor["target"]) <= sensor["tolerance"]
        )

        if in_zone:
            label.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #4CAF50; border: none;"
            )
            if index < len(self.sensor_frames):
                self.sensor_frames[index].setStyleSheet(
                    self._frame_inzone_style()
                )
        else:
            label.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
            )
            if index < len(self.sensor_frames):
                self.sensor_frames[index].setStyleSheet(
                    self._frame_normal_style()
                )

        self.progress_dots.set_state(index, in_zone)
        self._update_progress()

    # ================================================================
    def _update_progress(self):
        in_zone = 0
        for i, sensor in enumerate(self.sensors):
            if i >= len(self.controls):
                continue
            value = self.controls[i].value() / 10.0
            if abs(value - sensor["target"]) <= sensor["tolerance"]:
                in_zone += 1

        total = len(self.sensors)
        self.progress_count_label.setText(f"{in_zone} / {total}")

        if in_zone == total:
            self.progress_count_label.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #4CAF50; border: none;"
            )
        elif in_zone >= total // 2:
            self.progress_count_label.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
            )
        else:
            self.progress_count_label.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
            )

    # ================================================================
    # میان‌بر (cheat)
    # ================================================================
    def _on_shortcut(self):
        if self.is_done:
            return

        # ✅ پیام کاملاً ضمنی — پیشنهاد کمک از رحیمی
        #    هیچ اشاره‌ی صریحی به اخلاقیات یا عواقب نیست
        msg = QMessageBox(self)
        msg.setWindowTitle("پیام مهندس رحیمی")
        msg.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Information)
        msg.setText(
            "مهندس رحیمی: «تکنسین، راستش این چند روز "
            "همه‌مون تحت فشاریم. این حسگرها معمولاً نویز "
            "کمی دارن و تنظیمات کارخانه‌ای‌شون تقریباً "
            "کافیه. اگه بخوای، من الان از راه دور همه‌شون "
            "رو تأیید می‌کنم. تو وقتت رو بذار روی "
            "کار راکتور که فوری‌تره.»"
        )
        msg.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

        btn_accept = msg.addButton(
            "باشه، ممنون",
            QMessageBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole,
        )
        btn_refuse = msg.addButton(
            "نه، خودم انجام می‌دم",
            QMessageBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole,
        )
        msg.setDefaultButton(btn_refuse)
        msg.exec()

        if msg.clickedButton() != btn_accept:
            return

        self.cheat_used = True
        self.is_done = True
        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time

        results = []
        for sensor in self.sensors:
            results.append({
                "name": sensor["name"],
                "value": sensor["target"],
                "target": sensor["target"],
                "error": 0.0,
                "in_zone": True,
            })

        self._disable_all()
        self.submit_btn.setText("✓ ثبت شد")
        self.shortcut_btn.setText("✓ تأیید شد")

        # به‌روزرسانی بصری
        for i in range(len(self.sensors)):
            self.progress_dots.set_state(i, True)
            if i < len(self.value_labels):
                self.value_labels[i].setText(
                    f"{self.sensors[i]['target']:.1f}"
                )
                self.value_labels[i].setStyleSheet(
                    "color: #4CAF50; border: none;"
                )
            if i < len(self.sensor_frames):
                self.sensor_frames[i].setStyleSheet(
                    self._frame_inzone_style()
                )
        self._update_progress()

        self.calibration_done.emit({
            "results": results,
            "in_zone_count": len(self.sensors),
            "total_count": len(self.sensors),
            "out_zone_count": 0,
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
            "cheat_used": True,
        })

    # ================================================================
    # ثبت دقیق
    # ================================================================
    def _on_submit_normal(self):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        self.is_done = True
        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time

        results = []
        in_zone_count = 0
        for i, sensor in enumerate(self.sensors):
            value = self.controls[i].value() / 10.0
            error = abs(value - sensor["target"])
            in_zone = error <= sensor["tolerance"]
            if in_zone:
                in_zone_count += 1
            results.append({
                "name": sensor["name"],
                "value": round(value, 1),
                "target": sensor["target"],
                "error": round(error, 2),
                "in_zone": in_zone,
            })

        self._disable_all()
        self.submit_btn.setText("✓ کالیبراسیون ثبت شد")

        self.calibration_done.emit({
            "results": results,
            "in_zone_count": in_zone_count,
            "total_count": len(self.sensors),
            "out_zone_count": len(self.sensors) - in_zone_count,
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
            "cheat_used": False,
        })

    # ================================================================
    def _disable_all(self):
        for c in self.controls:
            c.setEnabled(False)
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.shortcut_btn.setEnabled(False)

"""

class _AnimatedCard(QFrame):
    """کارت شخصیت با انیمیشن ورود و Hover"""

    def __init__(self, dossier: dict, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._dossier = dossier
        self._accent = dossier["color"]
        self._hover_active = False

        self.setObjectName("dossierCard")
        self._apply_normal_style()
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

        self._build_content()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _apply_normal_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#dossierCard {{
                background-color: rgba(11, 29, 58, 0.7);
                border: 2px solid {self._accent};
                border-radius: 10px;
            }}
        """)

    def _apply_hover_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#dossierCard {{
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.85);
                border: 3px solid {self._accent};
                border-radius: 10px;
            }}
        """)

    def enterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._hover_active = True
        self._apply_hover_style()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._hover_active = False
        self._apply_normal_style()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_content(self):
        d = self._dossier

        )

        name_col = QVBoxLayout()
        name_col.setSpacing(2)

        name_lbl = QLabel(d["name"])
        nf = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 17, QFont.Weight.Bold)

        name_col.addWidget(name_lbl)

        role_lbl = QLabel(d["role"])
        role_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        role_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #B0BEC5; border: none; background: transparent;"
        )
        name_col.addWidget(role_lbl)

        head_row.addLayout(name_col, 1)

        # شمارنده
        counter_lbl = QLabel(
            f"{d['unlocked_count']} / {d['total_count']}"
        )
        counter_lbl.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        counter_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"""
            color: {accent};
            border: 1px solid {accent};
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            background: transparent;
        """)
        head_row.addWidget(counter_lbl)

        vbox.addLayout(head_row)

        # خط جداکننده
        sep = QFrame()
        sep.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.HLine)
        sep.setStyleSheet(
            f"background-color: {accent}; max-height: 1px; "
            "border: none;"
        )
        sep.setGraphicsEffect(self._make_opacity_effect(0.4))
        vbox.addWidget(sep)

        # ---------------- یادداشت‌ها ----------------
        if not d["notes"]:
            empty = QLabel("هنوز اطلاعاتی ثبت نشده.")

            vbox.addWidget(empty)

        if d["locked_count"] > 0:

            )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_note_row(self, note: dict, accent: str) -> QFrame:
        frame = QFrame()
        frame.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.5);
                border: none;
                border-radius: 6px;
            }
        """)
        nl = QHBoxLayout(frame)
        nl.setContentsMargins(12, 8, 12, 8)
        nl.setSpacing(8)

        bullet = QLabel("◆")
        bullet.setFont(QFont("Arial", 11))
        bullet.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {accent}; border: none; "
            "background: transparent;"
        )
        bullet.setFixedWidth(18)
        nl.addWidget(bullet)

        txt = QLabel(note["text"])
        txt.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        txt.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #E0E0E0; border: none; "
            "background: transparent;"
        )
        txt.setWordWrap(True)
        txt.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        txt.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignAbsolute
        )
        nl.addWidget(txt, 1)

        return frame

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _make_opacity_effect(value: float) -> QGraphicsOpacityEffect:
        eff = QGraphicsOpacityEffect()
        eff.setOpacity(value)
        return eff

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def animate_in(self, delay_ms: int = 0):
        """انیمیشن ورود: Fade-in + Slide از پایین"""
        # ابتدا شفافیت ۰
        opacity = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(self)
        opacity.setOpacity(0.0)
        self.setGraphicsEffect(opacity)

        # موقعیت اولیه (کمی پایین‌تر)
        final_pos = self.pos()
        start_pos = QPoint(final_pos.x(), final_pos.y() + 30)
        self.move(start_pos)

        # انیمیشن شفافیت
        fade_anim = QPropertyAnimation(opacity, b"opacity", self)
        fade_anim.setDuration(500)
        fade_anim.setStartValue(0.0)
        fade_anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        fade_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)

        # انیمیشن موقعیت
        pos_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b"pos", self)
        pos_anim.setDuration(500)
        pos_anim.setStartValue(start_pos)
        pos_anim.setEndValue(final_pos)
        pos_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)

        # نگه‌داشتن مرجع برای جلوگیری از GC
        self._fade_anim = fade_anim
        self._pos_anim = pos_anim

        def _start():
            fade_anim.start()
            pos_anim.start()
            # پاک کردن effect بعد از پایان
            fade_anim.finished.connect(
                lambda: self.setGraphicsEffect(None)
            )

        QTimer.singleShot(delay_ms, _start)

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (

RLM = "\u200F"
FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"

# ✅ تبدیل ارقام انگلیسی به فارسی
_PERSIAN_DIGITS = str.maketrans("0123456789", "۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹")


def to_persian_digits(text) -> str:
    """تبدیل ارقام انگلیسی به ارقام فارسی"""
    return str(text).translate(_PERSIAN_DIGITS)

# مدت انیمیشن ورود هر دکمه (ms)
FADE_IN_MS = 320
# تأخیر پله‌ای بین دکمه‌ها (ms)
STAGGER_DELAY_MS = 70
# تعداد گام‌های انیمیشن
ANIM_STEPS = 12

    def __init__(self, number: int, parent=None):
        # ✅ ارقام فارسی به‌جای انگلیسی
        super().__init__(to_persian_digits(number), parent)
        self.setFixedSize(32, 32)
        self.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.setFont(

                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 16px;
            }
        """)
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )

            "color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; "
            "border: none;"
        )
        self.label.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        )
        self.label.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignAbsolute
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )
        self.label.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        text_col.addWidget(self.label)

        layout.addLayout(text_col, 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_bg_intensity(self, value: float):
        """تنظیم شدت پس‌زمینه (برای انیمیشن ورود)"""
        self._bg_intensity = max(0.0, min(1.0, value))
        self._apply_style()

    def _apply_style(self):
        """اعمال استایل با شدت فعلی"""
        # رنگ پس‌زمینه بین #0B1D3A و #1A2A4A نوسان می‌کند
        intensity = self._bg_intensity
        # از شفافیت استفاده می‌کنیم (rgba)
        alpha = int(40 + 120 * intensity)  # 40 تا 160
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#choiceButton {{
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, {alpha / 255:.3f});
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }}
        """)

    def _apply_hover_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#choiceButton {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
        """)

    def enterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._apply_hover_style()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._apply_style()  # بازگشت به حالت عادی (با intensity فعلی)
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(self.choice_data)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)


# ====================================================================
# ویجت اصلی
# ====================================================================
class ChoiceWidget(QWidget):
    choice_made = pyqtSignal(dict, int)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.choices = []
        self.buttons = []
        self.decision_start_time = 0
        self.is_visible = False
        self._already_emitted = False
        self._scenario_id: str = ""
        # ✅ نگه‌داری تایمرهای انیمیشن
        self._anim_timers: list = []

        self._setup_ui()
        print("✓ ChoiceWidget راه‌اندازی شد (نسخه 2.2)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _setup_ui(self):
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        main_layout.setContentsMargins(30, 20, 30, 20)
        main_layout.setSpacing(12)

        title_label = QLabel("انتخاب کنید:")
        title_font = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 22)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        title_label.setFont(title_font)
        title_label.setStyleSheet("QLabel { color: #4FC3F7; }")
        title_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        main_layout.addWidget(title_label)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        scroll.setStyleSheet(
            "QScrollArea { background-color: transparent; "
            "border: none; }"
        )
        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(
            Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff
        )

        scroll_content = QWidget()
        scroll_content.setStyleSheet(
            "background-color: transparent;"
        )
        self.buttons_container = QVBoxLayout(scroll_content)
        self.buttons_container.setSpacing(14)
        self.buttons_container.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        self.buttons_container.addStretch()

        scroll.setWidget(scroll_content)
        main_layout.addWidget(scroll, stretch=1)

        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def show_choices(self, choices: list, scenario_id: str = ""):
        self._stop_all_anims()
        self._clear_buttons()
        self._already_emitted = False
        self._scenario_id = scenario_id

        shuffled = list(choices)
        random.shuffle(shuffled)

        self.choices = shuffled
        self.is_visible = True
        self.decision_start_time = time.time()

        for i, choice in enumerate(shuffled):
            display_number = i + 1
            btn = ChoiceButton(choice, display_number)
            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_choice_clicked)
            self.buttons_container.insertWidget(
                self.buttons_container.count() - 1, btn
            )
            self.buttons.append(btn)

            # ✅ شروع از شدت 0
            btn.set_bg_intensity(0.0)

            delay = i * STAGGER_DELAY_MS
            QTimer.singleShot(
                delay,
                lambda b=btn: self._animate_button_in(b),
            )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _animate_button_in(self, btn: ChoiceButton):
        """انیمیشن ورود با تغییر تدریجی رنگ پس‌زمینه"""
        try:
            _ = btn.width()
        except RuntimeError:
            return

        step = {"i": 0}

        timer = QTimer(self)

        def _tick():
            step["i"] += 1
            progress = min(1.0, step["i"] / ANIM_STEPS)
            try:
                btn.set_bg_intensity(progress)
            except RuntimeError:
                timer.stop()
                return
            if progress >= 1.0:
                timer.stop()

        timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
        interval = max(20, FADE_IN_MS // ANIM_STEPS)
        timer.start(interval)
        self._anim_timers.append(timer)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_choice_clicked(self, choice: dict):
        if self._already_emitted:
            print("⚠️ تلاش برای emit دوباره نادیده گرفته شد")
            return
        self._already_emitted = True

        decision_time = int(
            (time.time() - self.decision_start_time) * 1000
        )

        self.choice_made.emit(choice, decision_time)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _stop_all_anims(self):
        for timer in self._anim_timers:
            try:
                timer.stop()
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self._anim_timers.clear()

    def _clear_buttons(self):
        for button in self.buttons:
            try:
                self.buttons_container.removeWidget(button)
                button.deleteLater()
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self.buttons.clear()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def hide_choices(self):
        self._stop_all_anims()
        self._clear_buttons()
        self.is_visible = False
        self.hide()

    def is_showing(self) -> bool:
        return self.is_visible

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/context_menu.py

"""
منوی راست‌کلیک سراسری
========================
- روی هرجای بازی با راست‌کلیک ظاهر می‌شود
- شامل: ذخیره‌ی دستی، راهنمای کلیدها، بازگشت به منو، خروج
- در صحنه‌های فاز و منو کار می‌کند

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMenu, QMessageBox, QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QAction, QFont

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"


class GameContextMenu(QMenu):
    """منوی راست‌کلیک بازی"""

    def __init__(self, main_window, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.main_window = main_window

        self.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QMenu {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px;
                font-family: 'Vazirmatn';
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QMenu::item {
                padding: 8px 20px;
                border-radius: 4px;
            }
            QMenu::item:selected {
                background-color: #4FC3F7;
                color: #0B1D3A;
            }
            QMenu::separator {
                height: 1px;
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                margin: 4px 8px;
            }
        """)

        self._build_menu()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_menu(self):
        # ذخیره‌ی دستی
        save_action = QAction("💾  ذخیره‌ی دستی", self)
        save_action.triggered.connect(self._on_save)
        self.addAction(save_action)

        # بازگشت به منو
        menu_action = QAction("🏠  بازگشت به منو", self)
        menu_action.triggered.connect(self._on_back_to_menu)
        self.addAction(menu_action)

        self.addSeparator()

        # راهنمای کلیدها
        shortcuts_action = QAction("⌨️  راهنمای کلیدها", self)
        shortcuts_action.triggered.connect(
            self._on_show_shortcuts
        )
        self.addAction(shortcuts_action)

        # دفترچه
        log_action = QAction("📔  دفترچه‌ی مأموریت", self)
        log_action.triggered.connect(self._on_show_log)
        self.addAction(log_action)

        # پرونده
        dossier_action = QAction("👥  پرونده‌ی شخصیت‌ها", self)
        dossier_action.triggered.connect(self._on_show_dossier)
        self.addAction(dossier_action)

        self.addSeparator()

        # بستن منو
        close_action = QAction("✕  بستن منو", self)
        close_action.triggered.connect(self.close)
        self.addAction(close_action)

    # ================================================================
    def _on_save(self):
        try:
            from core.backup_manager import create_backup
            path = create_backup(reason="manual")
            if path:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self.main_window,
                    "ذخیره شد",
                    f"✓ پشتیبان ساخته شد:\n{path}",
                )
            else:
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self.main_window,
                    "خطا",
                    "ذخیره‌سازی ناموفق بود.",
                )
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self.main_window,
                "خطا",
                f"ذخیره‌سازی ناموفق:\n{e}",
            )

    def _on_back_to_menu(self):
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self.main_window,
            "بازگشت به منو",
            "آیا می‌خواهید به منوی اصلی بازگردید؟\n"
            "پیشرفت جلسه ذخیره می‌شود.",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
            | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        try:
            gm = self.main_window.game_manager
            # ذخیره‌ی وضعیت
            try:
                gm.save_session()
            except Exception:
                pass
            gm.change_scene("menu")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در بازگشت به منو: {e}")

    def _on_show_shortcuts(self):
        try:
            from widgets.shortcuts_panel import ShortcutsDialog
            dlg = ShortcutsDialog(self.main_window)
            dlg.exec()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در نمایش میانبرها: {e}")

    def _on_show_log(self):
        try:
            if hasattr(self.main_window, "_open_mission_log"):
                self.main_window._open_mission_log()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در نمایش دفترچه: {e}")

    def _on_show_dossier(self):
        try:
            if hasattr(
                self.main_window, "_open_character_dossier"
            ):
                self.main_window._open_character_dossier()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در نمایش پرونده: {e}")


def install_context_menu(widget: QWidget, main_window):
    """نصب منوی راست‌کلیک روی یک widget"""
    widget.setContextMenuPolicy(
        Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu
    )

    def _show_menu(pos):
        menu = GameContextMenu(main_window, widget)
        menu.exec(widget.mapToGlobal(pos))

    widget.customContextMenuRequested.connect(_show_menu)

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/decision_trail_widget.py

"""
نقشه‌ی تصمیم — خط افقی با نقاط توپر/خالی
============================================
طراحی بی‌طرف: هیچ رنگ یا کیفیتی نشان نمی‌دهد.
- نقطه‌ی توپر: تصمیم گرفته‌شده
- نقطه‌ی خالی: در انتظار

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QPointF
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QPen, QBrush, QColor


class DecisionTrailWidget(QWidget):
    """نقشه‌ی تصمیم — خط افقی با نقاط"""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._total: int = 0
        self._filled: int = 0
        self.setMinimumHeight(26)
        self.setMinimumWidth(180)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

    def set_total(self, total: int):
        self._total = max(0, int(total))
        self._filled = 0
        self.update()

    def mark_next(self):
        if self._filled < self._total:
            self._filled += 1
            self.update()

    def reset(self):
        self._filled = 0
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._total <= 0:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()
        cy = h / 2

        # نقطه‌های شروع و پایان
        margin = 12
        start_x = margin
        end_x = w - margin

        if self._total == 1:
            positions = [(start_x + end_x) / 2]
        else:
            step = (end_x - start_x) / (self._total - 1)
            positions = [start_x + i * step
                         for i in range(self._total)]

        # خط افقی
        line_color = QColor(79, 195, 247, 80)
        painter.setPen(QPen(line_color, 2))
        painter.drawLine(
            int(start_x), int(cy), int(end_x), int(cy)
        )

        # نقاط
        for i, x in enumerate(positions):
            if i < self._filled:
                # توپر
                painter.setPen(QPen(QColor("#4FC3F7"), 2))
                painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor("#4FC3F7")))
                painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(x, cy), 6, 6)
            else:
                # خالی
                painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 130), 2))
                painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
                painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(x, cy), 6, 6)

        painter.end()

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/dependency_board_widget.py

"""
ویجت تخته وابستگی — SPA-01
چیدمان دو ستونی با Drag & Drop واقعی

نسخه 3.0:
- کشیدن کارت‌ها از ستون راست به جایگاه‌های ستون چپ
- Drop روی هر جایگاه خالی
- جایگزینی کارت در جایگاه پر (با بازگشت کارت قبلی)
- بدون چک بصری ترتیب
- Undo برای حذف آخرین
- حفظ منطق distractor

نسخه: 3.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton,
    QFrame, QScrollArea
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import (
    Qt, QTimer, pyqtSignal, QMimeData, QPoint
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QDrag, QFont, QPainter, QColor, QPen, QBrush, QPixmap
)
import time

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"
MIME_TYPE = "application/x-truthline-action-id"


# ====================================================================
# کارت قابل کشیدن
# ====================================================================
class _DraggableCard(QFrame):
    """کارت اقدام که می‌توان آن را کشید"""

    def __init__(self, action: dict, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.action_id = action["id"]
        self._drag_start: QPoint | None = None
        self._is_disabled = False

        self.setObjectName("actionCard")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#actionCard {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.85);
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            QFrame#actionCard:hover {
                background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.20);
                border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)
        self.setMinimumHeight(64)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 6, 10, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        icon_lbl = QLabel(action.get("icon", "●"))
        icon_lbl.setFont(QFont("Arial", 18))
        icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("border: none;")
        icon_lbl.setFixedWidth(28)
        icon_lbl.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        layout.addWidget(icon_lbl)

        text_col = QVBoxLayout()
        text_col.setSpacing(2)

        name = QLabel(action["name"])
        name.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        name.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
        )
        name.setWordWrap(True)
        name.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        text_col.addWidget(name)

        brief = QLabel(action.get("brief", ""))
        brief.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 9))
        brief.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #B0BEC5; border: none;"
        )
        brief.setWordWrap(True)
        brief.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        text_col.addWidget(brief)

        layout.addLayout(text_col, 1)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._is_disabled:
            return
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self._drag_start = event.pos()
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.ClosedHandCursor)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)
        self._drag_start = None
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._is_disabled or self._drag_start is None:
            return
        if not (event.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            return
        dist = (event.pos() - self._drag_start).manhattanLength()
        if dist < 8:
            return

        drag = QDrag(self)
        mime = QMimeData()
        mime.setData(MIME_TYPE, self.action_id.encode("utf-8"))
        mime.setText(self.action_id)
        drag.setMimeData(mime)

        # نمای درگ
        pixmap = self.grab()
        # شفافیت ۸۰٪
        faded = QPixmap(pixmap.size())
        faded.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        painter = QPainter(faded)
        painter.setOpacity(0.8)
        painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, pixmap)
        painter.end()
        drag.setPixmap(faded)
        drag.setHotSpot(event.pos())

        drag.exec(Qt.DropAction.MoveAction)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)


# ====================================================================

    def clear_action(self):
        self._filled_action_id = None
        self.icon_lbl.setText("—")
        self.name_lbl.setText("خالی")
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #666666; border: none;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self._apply_style()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.mimeData().hasFormat(MIME_TYPE):
            self._is_highlighted = True
            self._apply_style()
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def dragLeaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._is_highlighted = False
        self._apply_style()

    def dropEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._is_highlighted = False
        self._apply_style()
        if event.mimeData().hasFormat(MIME_TYPE):
            action_id = bytes(
                event.mimeData().data(MIME_TYPE)
            ).decode("utf-8")
            self.dropped.emit(self.slot_index, action_id)
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def _on_clear_clicked(self):
        if self._filled_action_id is not None:
            self.cleared.emit(self.slot_index)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_slots_column(self):
        container = QFrame()
        container.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(255, 143, 0, 0.05);
                border: 2px dashed #FF8F00;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(4)

        header = QLabel("ترتیب اقدامات")
        header.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        header.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
        )
        header.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(header)

        for i in range(len(self.correct_order)):
            slot = _DropSlot(i)
            slot.dropped.connect(self._on_slot_dropped)
            slot.cleared.connect(self._on_slot_cleared)
            layout.addWidget(slot)
            self.slots.append(slot)

        layout.addStretch()
        return container

    # ================================================================
    def _on_slot_dropped(self, slot_index: int, action_id: str):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        if action_id in self.sequence:
            # کارت قبلاً استفاده شده
            return

        if self.first_action_time == 0:
            self.first_action_time = (
                int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time
            )

        # اگر جایگاه قبلاً پر است، کارت قبلی را آزاد کن
        existing = self.slots[slot_index].get_action_id()
        if existing is not None:
            if existing in self.sequence:
                self.sequence.remove(existing)
            # برگرداندن کارت به حالت فعال
            self._set_card_active(existing, True)

        # پر کردن جایگاه
        action = self.action_map.get(action_id, {})
        self.slots[slot_index].set_action(
            action_id,
            action.get("name", "?"),
            action.get("icon", "●"),
        )
        self._set_card_active(action_id, False)

        # به‌روزرسانی sequence
        self.sequence = []
        for slot in self.slots:
            sid = slot.get_action_id()
            if sid is not None:
                self.sequence.append(sid)

        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_slot_cleared(self, slot_index: int):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        action_id = self.slots[slot_index].get_action_id()
        if action_id is None:
            return

        self.slots[slot_index].clear_action()
        if action_id in self.sequence:
            self.sequence.remove(action_id)
        self._set_card_active(action_id, True)

        # به‌روزرسانی sequence
        self.sequence = []
        for slot in self.slots:
            sid = slot.get_action_id()
            if sid is not None:
                self.sequence.append(sid)

        self._update_buttons()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _set_card_active(self, action_id: str, active: bool):
        card = self.action_cards.get(action_id)
        if card is None:
            return
        card._is_disabled = not active
        if active:
            card.setVisible(True)
            card.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#actionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.85);
                    border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
                QFrame#actionCard:hover {
                    background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.20);
                    border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                }
            """)
        else:
            card.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#actionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.3);
                    border: 2px solid #444444;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
            """)

    def _update_buttons(self):
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(
            len(self.sequence) == len(self.correct_order)
        )

    # ================================================================
    def _on_submit(self):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        if len(self.sequence) != len(self.correct_order):
            return
        self.is_done = True

        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time

        distractor_ids = [
            a["id"] for a in self.action_list
            if a.get("is_distractor", False)
        ]

        score = self._sequence_score(
            self.sequence, self.correct_order, distractor_ids
        )

        distractor_used = [
            item for item in self.sequence
            if item in distractor_ids
        ]

        result = {
            "sequence": list(self.sequence),
            "correct_order": list(self.correct_order),
            "sequence_score": score,
            "planning_time_ms": self.first_action_time,
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
            "distractor_ids": distractor_ids,
            "distractor_used": distractor_used,
            "distractor_count": len(distractor_used),
        }
        print(f"   [DEBUG] نتیجه SPA-01: {result}")
        self.board_done.emit(result)

    def _sequence_score(self, seq: list, correct: list,
                         distractor_ids: list | None = None) -> float:
        if distractor_ids is None:
            distractor_ids = []

        m, n = len(seq), len(correct)
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if seq[i - 1] == correct[j - 1]:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = max(
                        dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]
                    )

        base_score = dp[m][n] / max(1, n)
        distractor_count = sum(
            1 for item in seq if item in distractor_ids
        )
        penalty = distractor_count * 0.15

        final = max(0.0, base_score - penalty)
        return round(final, 3)

    def _tick_pulse(self):

        self._pulse_phase += 0.1
        if self._pulse_phase > 2 * math.pi:
            self._pulse_phase -= 2 * math.pi
        # ✅ فقط اگر visible و اندازه معقول دارد، update کن
        if not self.isVisible():
            return
        if self.width() < 10 or self.height() < 10:
            return
        self.update()

        super().hideEvent(event)
        if self._pulse_timer.isActive():
